mods.description:
This is Bitforts, an Arena & Hangout map for your preferred version of sm64coop. (it works on both)

Be mindful of which version you download, as one is specifically for Arena (included with your game) and the other is for Hangout (which isn't a real gamemode, but something you can add onto your game).

The Arena version automatically adds itself to the map pool through its api, but for those using the Hangout version, a very simple implementation is provided to allow people to access the map through the /retrowarp command. mods.description:
This add-on mod lets players engage with 1v1 battles with each other at any time! Simply type /duel [player name] to request a duel! Other commands include:

/forceduel [NAME|ID,NAME|ID] - As a host or moderator, force two players to battle.
/bestof [NUM] - Set the amount of wins needed for a match.
/sky [0-2] - Set the background and music for a match.
/time [SEC] - Set the time until Sudden Death.
/forfeit - Leave a duel.
/spectate-duel [NAME|ID] - Spectate another duel.

You can also enter "random" for /duel and /forceduel to pick a random player. Do NOT use with game modes.

mods.name: Sonic Character: Rebooted
mods.author: steven3004
mods.description:
This is a mod that adds Sonic and friends as a playable character in sm64ex-coop.


This mod can be used two ways:

As a Character Select pack: Adds two characters with movesets and palettes to the CS menu.
As a standalone mod: Type /sonic in chat to turn on Sonic characters. Each character overwrites a vanilla character's slot, the list goes:


Mario: Sonic
Luigi: ?
Toad: Amy Rose
Waluigi: ?
Wario: ?


Sonic replaces Mario, and is faster than the vanilla cast, and he also brings some new tricks to the table.


Momentum tweaks: When running or landing Sonic doesn't lose any speed that he has gained. If you let go of the analog stick he'll decelerate instead of stopping immediately.
Air control: While airborne, during some moves, he can turn around in the air and change directions.
No swimming. He instead has a limited version of his ground moveset.
Fall damage is delayed a bit for Sonic.
B button (ground):


Spindash: Hold the B button to charge the spindash, and let go to dash off rollin'. Ya can also spam it and gain some speed, but it's capped.
Sonic Eagle: Hold A and press B and he'll do the Sonic Eagle from Sonic Battle, which is basically a reskinned Jump Kick here.
Windmill Kick: This move replaces Mario's slide kick. By pressng B while crouch-slidin', Sonic will do a spinning kick, attacking most enemies and bouncin' off walls.


B button (air):


Sonic Eagle: Basically the same move, but ya have to let go of the analog stick t' do it.
Dropdash: Hold B in the air with the analog stick and you'll start a dropdash. If ya hold it until you hit the ground, you'll get more speed and start rollin'. If ya release it in the air, you'll instead perform an airdash. If ya hold it until ya hit a wall, you'll climb upwards. The faster you are, the higher you'll jump up.


Bound Jump: Sonic's replacement fer the ground pound. Press Z and you'll bounce on the ground, break stuff, and be immune t' fall damage. Though keep in mind that you'll have less air control.
Grabbing: Just spindash or roll into an object.

Amy goes over Toad, is mostly similar to Sonic in terms of physics, but she has moves of her own that makes for a different play style.
(Her voice clips are mostly unfinished for now.)


Passive abilities:
1. Amy's jump height is much higher than Sonic's and most of the vanilla cast.
2. She can swim, unlike Sonic, but instead of a breaststroke, she only has a flutter kick, and her speed increases the same way it does on land



Giant Steps:
1. This move replaces the Long Jump, in which Amy leaps forward in the held direction, allowing her to gain speed and redirect momentum immediately while on the ground.
2.  Keep in mind that this move doesn't have air mobility and there is a bit of delay for using the move.
    + By pressing B during the move, she will trip over and do what's basically just a reskinned dive.
Hammer Attack: The most basic melee move. You press B on the ground and she'll whack her hammer instead of punching or kicking.
Hammer Twirl: By crouching and holding B, Amy will spin with her hammer and bounce off walls. You're able to change your direction by a bit during this move if yer moving, and it slows you down when you're on the ground.
Hammer Flip:
1. While Amy's in the air, if you press or hold B, she'll spin forwards with her hammer.
2. While the move is being done, she can bounce up walls, retaining some speed and gaining height based on the speed. Note that ya gotta be fully and constantly spinning fer this to be possible. Run into a wall too early and she'll just bonk off of it.
Hammer Jump: When ya press A within a few frames of her hitting her hammer, either from a Hammer Attack or landing with a Hammer Flip, she'll propel upwards. The height you gain depends on how fast you go. This is also how ya fly with the Wing Cap.
Hammer Pound:
1. This is basically just a simple replacement fer the Ground Pound where she spins her hammer downwards.
2. If you press and hold B during the move, she'll thrust forwards a bit and do the Hammer Twirl.

mods.name: Tag
mods.author: EmeraldLockdown
mods.description:
Tag

This mod is a collection of multiple gamemodes all in one mod! The mod contains 9 gamemodes, modifiers that effect the gameplay of the gamemode, in-depth, easy to understand settings, and statistics!

Gamemodes

Tag contains multiple tag-related gamemodes! All gamemodes involve "tagging" another player. There are as of right now 9 different gamemodes. These gamemodes are Tag, Freeze Tag, Infection, Hot Potato, Juggernaut (meh), Assassins, Sardines, Hunt, and Deathmatch! Each gamemode gives it's own fun to the mod!

Modifiers

There are plenty of modifiers to add variety your game! From simple gravity changes to blasters and fog, modifiers add plenty of enjoyable (or annoying) changes to the base gamemodes!

Romhacks

Romhack support depends on the romhack. Offical romhacks have paintings, and pipes like vanilla levels! Non-official romhacks don't have these benefits, however, the romhack should still work perfectly fine!

Arena Stage

Arena Stages are fully supported, with pipes and all! It is highly recommended to play with arena stages. Downside is you don't get paintings.

Official Tag Stages

Tag Stages include paintings and custom-placed pipes, these are perfect mods to add to your tag experience!

Blacklists

Don't like a gamemode, modifier, or level? Blacklist it! Blacklisting allows you to turn off certain gamemods, modifiers, or levels that you don't like in your game.

Stats

Each player has stats! These stats go from playtime, total tags, and total time as runner, to total runner victories and tagger victories. The best part is each gamemode gets it's own statistics for each of these metrics!

Frequently Asked Questions


sm64ex-coop/sm64coopdx Support:

This mod supports both repos. If you encounter a bug with a specific one, make an issue here so it can be addressed.

Romhack Compatibility:

Yes, Tag supports romhacks. You can add paintings and more to romhacks by creating what's called an official hack (wow great name!). You can learn how to do that here. The mod also includes a blacklist to remove incompatible levels.

Code Usage:

Generally, you can use code from this mod for your own projects. Credit is not required, but ensure you understand the code and avoid copying large portions without modification.

Custom Versions:

You're welcome to publish custom versions of this mod. However, consider contributing to the main repo first. Ensure your custom version doesn't include code from unreleased versions or other mods without proper credit. Include me in the credits, and I reserve the right to incorporate your code into the base Tag with appropriate credit.

Contributing to the Repo:

Fork the repo here and contribute by creating pull requests.

Bug Reports and Suggestions:

Report bugs or suggestions here.

Update Notifications:

You can make an account on this site here, and you'll be emailed for when this mod is updated!

Contact Information:

If you need to contact me, visit my profile here.

Arena Map Support:

Yes, Tag supports arena maps and automatically adds pipes based on the CTF flags, and set your spawn to the Flag Tag flag spawn. For additional features like paintings, check out this repo, where well-known arena maps are ported.

mods.name: Backup Star Warp
mods.author: wereyoshi
mods.description:
when collecting a star or key spawn a star copy that other players can use to follow you. Made for scenarios where you need to collect a star to go to a certain place which would otherwise require you to take turns collecting the star or synchronize your star collection with other players. if everyone wanted to go there.

This mod has an api _G.backupstarwarp which contains
getversion - this function returns the back up star warp version
get_backupstarwarpbehaviorid - this function returns the behavior id of the fake star
addactioncheck - this function is for adding actions that you want backup star warps to have ignore backup stars
addtostaridcheck - this function is for if you want backup star warps to only work for certain stars

mods.name: Hangout - Final Fantasy 7 - Gaia Overworld
mods.author: BuckleyTim
mods.description:
This was supposed to be an April Fools joke entitled "FF7 FULL GAME (REAL)", but bugs and crashing errors got too far in the way for me to meet my self-imposed deadilne. Those are all fixed now, so I might as well upload what I consider to be pushing the limits of coopdx's ability to render exported maps as workable level entries.

This mod contains 3 hangout maps representing the northern, eastern, and western continents of FF7's overworld map. There are a few errors (such as the bridges on the west continent) but given how long it takes to export these maps it's passable I suppose.

Probably for the best if you play this with a mod that increases your movement abilities. Or maybe not, sometimes it's just cool to get lost in the world of another game from Mario's point of view...

Edit:
Access the maps by typing either /ff7-east , /ff7-west , or /ff7-north into the chat.

Also comes with a midislap I did of the overworld/main theme into a combo of the m64 and mario party 2 soundfonts.

mods.name: No BLJs
mods.author: Spring E. Thing
mods.description:
Enabling this script as a mod when hosting a server for SM64-CoOp DX will prevent the famous 'Backwards Long Jump' glitch from being possible.

Server hosts have access to the chat command /no-blj. Executing this chat command proving either an argument of on or off will enable or disable the mod respectively. By default, the mod is on.

This script is an edit of an existing script by community member 'Sunk' who's script was intended to permit the BLJ glitch to be possible regardless of the properties of the surface Mario was performing the glitch upon. The script that I wrote for this addon pretty much just inverts the conditions and removes some unneccessary sections past this decision such that the one condition under which the BLJ glitch is possible in vanilla SM64 no longer exists.

mods.name: Climb Attack!
mods.author: eeliottheking
mods.description:
In Climb Attack, players race to climb as high as possible on a randomly generated tower by strategically placing blocks. The goal is to outclimb your opponents and reach the highest point before the time runs out. The player who climbs the highest wins the round!

This mod introduces a block-building mechanic inspired by Minecraft, allowing players to construct their way up the tower using a limited number of blocks. Players must carefully manage their block resources and plan their ascent while avoiding obstacles and competing against other climbers.

Key Features:
- Random tower generation: Each round, a new tower is procedurally generated, ensuring a fresh and challenging experience every time.
- Block building: Use the Y button to place blocks and create your path upwards. Punching or kicking blocks will refund your block count.

WARNING: This mode has a LOT of objects!  Do not play with 16 players!  Do not play with 10 players with max settings for the tower!  You will get lag!  If you experience desynch due to lag, issue /round restart to try and resolve the issue!

Chat Commands (for server host):
- /round restart: Force the current round to restart and initiate a new cleanup round.
- /set-num-boxes (number): Set the number of boxes to spawn for the tower (default: 100).
- /set-match-duration (number): Set the duration of each match in seconds (default: 90).
- /set-box-vertical-range (number): Set the vertical spawn range for boxes in box units (default: 50).
- /set-box-horizontal-range (number): Set the horizontal spawn range for boxes in box units (default: 5).
- /set-player-boxes (number): Set the maximum number of blocks each player can place (default: 10).

Credits:
Creator: eeliottheking

Music by Eric Matyas - www.soundimage.org
Map (Roblox Baseplate) by beardenthusiast
Minecraft mod by zKevin

Special thanks to all the publicly available mods on the GitHub repository for providing valuable information and resources!

mods.author: PeachyPeach
mods.description:
Portals in Super Mario 64.
Inspired by Portal (the game).

Controls:

D-pad left: Shoot a blue portal.
D-pad right: Shoot an orange portal.
D-pad down: Close both portals.
D-pad up: Enable/disable first person mode.


Portal shots open a portal when they collide with a surface, an object or another player.
When two portals are open, touch one of them to get teleported to the other one instantly.
You can move almost any object from a portal to another, including other players.

In first person mode, move the camera with the mouse or the right stick.
The first person camera uses the settings of the free cam, so, if you want to change the sensitivity of the camera or invert the axes, pause the game, open the Options and go to Camera.
Bind D-pad left/D-pad right to your mouse left button/right button for a better experience.

mods.name: Wanted!
mods.author: PeachyPeach
mods.description:
Remember that New Super Mario Bros./Super Mario 64 DS minigame?

This mod includes both a single player and a multiplayer version.
The goal is simple: the player has to find one of the four characters (Mario, Luigi, Wario or Toad) amongst a large crowd of the others.
You can play with a controller, but also with a mouse: bind your A button to the right click (not left), and you're ready to play!

Single player
The default version. The player starts with 10 seconds and gain 5 seconds and 1 point each time they select the wanted character, but lose 10 seconds if they select any other one. The game ends when the player runs out of time.

Multiplayer
This version is auto-enabled as soon as another player joins the game. Players have 30 seconds to find as many wanted characters as possible. Selecting the wanted character gives 1 point, but selecting any other one removes 1 point. The game ends when the timer reaches 0, and the player who has the most points win.

Settings
Some commands to customize your game:

/wanted scores: View your single player high scores. Only the top 5 ones are saved.
/wanted settings: View the game settings.

Host only:

/wanted reset: Reset the game settings to their default value.
/wanted <setting> <value>: Change a setting before the game starts.

Settings are:

level_start: Starting level.
time_start: Starting time in seconds (single player).
time_max: Max time in seconds (single player).
time_bonus: Time gained in seconds (single player).
time_penalty: Time lost in seconds (single player).
time_multi: Duration in seconds of a multiplayer session.

mods.name: Character Movesets
mods.author: steven3004
mods.description:
One of the older mods of sm64ex-coop is back with a slight bit of overhaul, giving each character fairly unique ways to play.

This mod can be toggled by typing /char-mov, in case you prefer your typical vanilla experience. (The moveset is on by default.)


Moves list:

Mario:

Handstand Jump (Crawling + A): Taken some inspiration from DK94 and Mario VS DK, this is basically a triple jump that goes higher, but has less speed. It's ideal for reaching higher spaces that can't be reached with a backflip or a side flip when there is no space to build up a triple jump, or just a fun lil' alternative to any of the aforementioned jumps.


Luigi:

Passive Stats: Luigi can jump higher and swim faster, but his shoes are rather slippery, therefore affecting his ground traction and speed, and wall kick height.
He also has slightly weaker health.
Scuttle Jump: By holding A while falling down during some jumps, Luigi will kick his feet to fall slower.

Spindrift Backflip: Taken straight from SM64DS, Luigi will do a spinning jump after he falls from a backflip.

Spin Pound (Holding Z): Basically a ground pound, but without the 2 second stop in mid-air and you have more control over it.


Toad:

Passive Stats: Toad is the fastest character out of the cast. His ground pound goes faster and running can maintain more speed, but his jump height is the worst. His wall kick, however, can be stronger with speed.
Ground Pound Jump: Pressing A while landing with a ground pound basically lets Toad do a higher triple jump.


Waluigi: 

Passive Stats: Waluigi moves slightly faster, and jumps slightly lower, while his triple jump is significantly buffed.
But due to being built like a stick bug, he loses way more health than any other character.
Wall Slide: Instead of light-bonking onto a wall, Waluigi will slide against it, and triples jumps out of one when A is pressed.

Elegant Jump: A take one Waluigi's double jump, where upon pressing A during some jumps, Waluigi will twirl in the air with all is Walugrace and be able to instantly switch directions.

Air Swim (Dive + B): Waluigi can defy gravity and swim three times before he falls to a place that's hopefully not his impending doom.


Wario:

Passive Stats: Wario is a much heavier and stronger guy, so he jumps lower and moves slower.
He falls faster with a ground pound and sinks when he's underwater.
He can effortlessly lift heavy objects and loses little to virtually no damage, except when he touches lava.
Shoulder Bash (Ground Dive): With this ability, Wario can ram into enemies and objects and send 'em flying.


Corkscrew Conk (Bash + A): A jump that's roughly the height of a double jump Wario can do while shoulder-bashing. He can also do it mid-air, making it a decent recovery move.


Wild Swing-Ding: By rotating the stick quickly while running with and object, Wario can spin it like spining Bowser. Note that for now, this is more of a neat visual thing rather than affecting how far you can throw the object.

Piledriver: Pressing Z while jumping with an object in hand and Wario will go pummeling down with it.




Hope you all enjoy the mod!

mods.name: Milne the Crystal Fox
mods.author: steven3004
mods.description:
Trailer:


You ever wanted to be a silly crystal fox zooming around stages, throwing rocks at enemies and do Russian dances?

No?

Well here's the mod anyway.

Milne just somehow got transported to Mario's world and she decided to help save the princess, I guess.

Usage:

As a standalone mod:

Type /milne on|off to toggle the character.
Type /milnecolor on|off to toggle recolorability.

As a CS Character: Two options for a non-recolorable Milne and a recolorable Milne will be in the menu.

Moveset:

Twister Thok: In the air, you can press A to start a Twister Thok. You can use it two times. First time will launch you upwards, second time downwards. Hold a direction, and you will lunge forwards in said direction. Otherwise it'd be your average double jump. If you try to do this move more than once without landing, you'll immediately launch downwards.
Melee (Punch, Kick and Dive replacement):

Shard Toss: Tap B once, and Milne will throw three crystal shards at once, acting as a projectile that damages enemies and players in PVP.
Crystal Lance: Quickly double tap B, and Milne will take out her lance and glide across the air in a short time. If she hits a wall, she'll stick to it, and you can either jump off of it (A), kick off of it (B), or drop off of it (Z). You can only use it once.
Grab: Getting near a grabbable object and press B will make Milne effortlessly pick it up.

Passive:

No Swimming: Milne can't swim, but she will have a slightly tweaked version of her ground moveset:

Twister Thok: Milne can now jump up more than once in the air in case she does the move again.
Crystal Lance: Milne can now use the move more than once with a 1-second timer if she's off-ground.

Weight: Due to being made out of crystals, Milne is denser and heavier, therefore she falls faster than most characters. And when she lands from certain heights, she'll create a shockwave that kills everything in its radius except for players. Her fall damage is also delayed a bit.

Kazotsky Kick (Taunt):

By pressing X as a Milne player while idling, you will do start dancing.
As a non-Milne player, you can go up to a dancing player. When an icon appears above the dancing player, you can press X and join 'em. Each vanilla character can have a unique dance, and you can make your character have a unique dance with this template file below:

This file makes Wario be able to only activate the dance while walking instead of idling and gives him Waluigi's dance.


With that out of the way, I hope y'all enjoy this mod!

ganewatch: Projectile code borrowed from Mega-Man X.

The original SRB2 Milne mod: The other things.

mods.name: Sharen's Improved Swimming
mods.author: Ex Coop Mods Archive
mods.description:
Sharen's Improved Swimming

List of changes:

- Instead of rotating Mario to the desired direction and pressing A at a specific rhythm, you now simply pull the stick to where you wanna go and Mario will simply go there, with no need to mash A as he'll stroke on his own, if you wish to go up or down, just hold A or Z.

- Entering water no longer puts you in a state where you have to wait for Mario to stop moving downwards, instead, you get to control him right away! In addition, if you enter water while already having considerable speed (most commonly via dives or long jumps) you'll get to keep extra speed you'd normally never reach!

- Shells are no longer a stupid joke, their duration was buffed from 8 seconds (yeah I didn't believe it either) to 30, alongside making you swim significantly faster as well as letting you halt to a complete stop faster! Oh yeah, you can also carry them out of the water if you wish, not sure how that's gonna be useful though.

- Metal Mario CAN swim now! You still sink, though, and swimming upwards will be noticeably slower, but hey, at least you get to swim downwards really fast.

- Water grabbing now doubles as a dash, very useful if you haven't entered water the proper way (a.k.a diving) or lost speed, though I wouldn't recommend using it if you did dive, as you'll lose your extra speed

If for some reason you wish to stick to the old way, you can! Simply type /better-swim and that will toggle the mod on or off.

mods.name: Super Smash Bros. Co-op
mods.author: Keeberghrh
mods.description:
Super Smash Bros. Co-op v0.1
After two months, this mod is being released! 

As a quick warning: Larger player counts may break the game.
It is recommended you stick to smaller groups, between 2 and 5 players.
The mod works with more players, but game breaking bugs seem more common with higher player counts.

Features
10 fighters! 5 Additional Characters
Mario - Basic fighter, closest to vanilla movement.
Luigi - Similar to Mario, but with different aerials.
Toad - Fast and powerful attacks.
Waluigi - Has attacks that can combo fairly well.
Wario - Heavy hitter, but slow on the ground.

New Characters
Bowser - Powerful attacks, fire breath and heavier than most fighters. (Model by @wibblus, thank you :D)Kirby - Has Inhale as a Special to copy your opponent's Special.
King Bob-omb - Can throw Bob-ombs which deal a lot of damage. Very heavy and large hurtbox.
Sonic - Fastest fighter, but slightly weaker.
Emerl - Can copy all characters! By pressing DPAD UP, Emerl enters a menu where any individual attack can be chosen and swapped out. Saves to mod storage.

Three Gamemodes!
Smash Mode - Regular Smash, dealing damage increases your opponent's %!
Stamina Mode - Instead of %, damage simply lowers your opponent's HP.
Boss Mode - The Host selects one player to be the Boss. The Boss has heavy armour, takes reduced knockback, a health bar, and can be resized to be larger or smaller. Non-Boss Players have to work to defeat the boss!

Grounded + B + Idle    = Jab
Grounded + B + Running = Dash Attack
Grounded + B + Crouch  = Special
Aerial + B             = Aerial
Ground Pound + A       = Recovery
Ground Pound + B       = Ground Pound Dive

Enjoy! :D

Toad: Lower jump, higher running speed.

Wario: Dies in a singular hit, hold the punch button in the air to hover for a limited time.

This also adds some quality-of-life improvements:

Hold the punch button while twirling to descend much faster.
Landing from a twirl no longer stops you from moving for a bit.

mods.name: [CS] Cream the Rabbit
mods.author: Gamebun
mods.description:
Note: If voicelines are not playing, you must be on Character Select v1.16.1 or above!


Cream's birthday is all over but she still wants to have fun! Escaped from her own mod, she explores the vast worlds of CoopDX! I know there's been a few ports by others of this model (and I appreciate it) though I figure I get an official version from me, with some extra bits.

Comes with a customizable palette, new animations replacing the idle, sleep and running anims, custom sounds, health hud, life and star icon and new star model. As of v2.0, she now regains the ability to fly as well as bringing along several of her outfits from Cream 64! As of v3.0, Vanilla has joined the pack as a replacement for Peach! This also includes replacing the two Toads at the end with their chao, Cheese & Chocola!

Simply press (A) to fly out of any of the jumps, the side flips and wall kicks. You need to press (B) to fly out of a long jump and then press (A) to keep flying. This is built to allow players to still be able to do the BLJ if needed.

A companion mod, Cheese the Chao, is also available!

Cream's outfits are also separated into four packs to not overwhelm players when there's suddenly 80+ outfits on her single slot. Simply place the main folder (char-select-cream) alongside any of the other pack folders in the mods folder to install the mod correctly.

If you simply just wanna play as Cream, you only need to worry about the main pack and can ignore the rest. The packs are:

Main: The Rabbit Herself
Contains her default design, remade to allow custom palettes!

Pack 1: Canon Outfits + a Few Extras


Pack 2: Sonic & Friends


Pack 3: Cream Cosplay Vol 1


Pack 4: Cream Cosplay Vol 2


While there are more outfits available in Super Cream 64, the remaining ones not in these packs were omitted on purpose since they were all created for friends, mutuals and streamers. If they do wish to let these be available through this mod, this page will be updated but don't expect those anytime soon.

Models created and/or ported by Gamebun
Hud sprites all created by SketchMeister
Custom Graffiti art and peach letter art by Funkys0da
Custom Cream voicelines by MagicalPoptarts
Original flight code by Alonwoof, ported over to Lua by AloXado320
General api and lua code implementation by AloXado320

Give yourself a little challenge and collect as many stars as you can by hopping around as a Goomba in his Iconic Green Shoe from Super Mario Bros 3!




HOP into the action by literally HOP into the action! (Walking is no longer possible)
The shoe's flat surface prevents you from drowning into the quicksand (Just try not to move more often)
Higher triple jump, but lower normal jump



Trouble when flying? there's a new way to do it: While performing Super Dropkick with the wing "cap", quickly press the A button to activate the wings on your back. You can also do this over and over again in the air as long as you got the wing cap



Speaking of cap, you won't find some anytime soon, we're replaced them with TOTALLY NOT DEAD Goombas....
You're immune to spinies now. Cause why not?
Requires character select to play
You may or may not drown faster with the use of the shoe in water



Key of the moveset (GROUND POUND!):

A new way to triple jump: When landing from a ground pound, press the A button to perform the higher triple jump
Super Dropkick: When ground pounding in the air, press the B button to perform a dropkick with a very HORIZONTAL directions, you can also do it when landing from a ground pound
Super Jump Kick: When ground pounding in the air, press the A button to perform a jump kick with a more higher range. Useful if you need a little boost upwards
If you think the distance of your dropkick is a little too far, just stop it with a ground pound. You can also ground pound in situations like jumping from a top of the pole or a little rising surfaces


Download the mod and receive yourself the Iconic Replica of the Green Shoe and  a TOTALLY REPLICA of the TOTALLY NOT DEAD Goomba with wings! ....Please?

A CONTROLLER IS REQUIRED FOR MUCH SMOOTHER GAMEPLAY OF CHARACTER!
THIS MOD REQUIRES CHARACTER SELECT MOD V1.11.2 AND ABOVE

Special Thanks to Melzinoff for the Goomba voicelines and the rest of SM64COOPDX Modding Community for helping me with Coding Materials!

All jokes aside, this is the first mod that i ever made and i'm looking forward to hear your opinions about the mod, how can i upgrade it,  the problems you encountered, and etc.

Therefore, feel free to contact me on the SM64COOPDX discord if you had any of these thoughts above

Last but not least, thank you for downloading my mod and Have Fun!
- PakPecik

mods.name: Minecraft Music Mod
mods.author: iZePlayz
mods.description:
# 🎶 Minecraft Music Mod v3.0 🎶 
Category: Audio

### What's New in v3.0:

Enhanced Randomization: The randomization of track selection has been significantly improved for a more varied and enjoyable listening experience.
Code Overhaul: A substantial amount of code has been rewritten, leading to better performance and stability.
Bug Fixes: Various bugs have been resolved to ensure smoother operation.
New Commands: Added /songlist to list all tracks and /skipto <Song-ID> to skip to a specific track by its ID.


### Mod Description:
This mod brings the original 41 tracks from C418's Minecraft soundtrack into your gameplay. The default in-game music is disabled, and the mod plays the Minecraft tracks in a random order. After each track, there is a brief pause of 10 to 20 seconds, mimicking the music transitions found in Minecraft, but with shorter delays.

Features:

Original Soundtrack: Plays all 41 tracks from C418's Minecraft soundtrack randomly.
Random Intervals: Pauses of 10-20 seconds between tracks for a more authentic Minecraft experience.
Default Music Disabled: The game's default background music is turned off.


Commands:

/skip - Skip the current track and play the next one.
/song - Display the current track and show the time remaining until the next track starts.
/songlist - Lists all songs with their ID, name, and filename.
/skipto <Song-ID> - Skip to the specified track by its ID.


### Important Installation Information:
To ensure the mod functions correctly, all 4 parts of the mod must be loaded and enabled. You can do this in one of two ways:
1. Extract Method: Extract all 4 folders from the zip file into your game’s mods folder.
2. Drag and Drop Method: Drag and drop the minecraft-music_v3-0_all-parts.zip file into the game. This will automatically load all 4 parts at once.

Note for Game Hosts: If you are hosting a game, make sure that all 4 parts of the mod are enabled on your server to ensure the Minecraft music plays correctly for everyone.

A - Confirm

CAP/POWER SELECT:

L MODE:

mods.name: LiveSplit64
mods.author: Isaac0-dev
mods.description: This is a simple coop mod that I made in an attempt to make a LiveSplit clone. For those who don't know: "LiveSplit is a timer program for speedrunners that is both easy to use and full of features." - LiveSplit I made this because I had the idea to be able to see each other's splits on the same LiveSplit window. This coop mod syncs with each player, so you can see when someone splits in real time. It comes built in with an autosplitter, so hopefully no need to split manually at the moment. To open a simple menu, press D-pad up and C-up at the same time. On this menu, you can move the timer around to where you want. There are a few buttons, allowing you to start/stop and reset the timer, and edit splits. Splits are saved thanks to mod storage on the host's machine only, but splits are synced when players join. I'd love some feedback on this mod! This was just something I decided to make as a fun challenge, so it's not exactly overflowing with features at the moment. I hope this mod is useful!

...Which is why I'm uploading this map in an unfinished state (omitting stuff like custom music and a skybox) as I hope to garner a bit of player feedback for this map. Let me know what you guys think of it so I can fine-tune it.

Have a fun time fragging!

----

Known bugs so far:

- One of the springs causes script errors despite working perfectly fine. I am unsure why.

-Animations for the arena weapons bugs out hard while in a swimming state. Nothing unplayable though visually it doesn't work right.

-KOTH hill doesn't spawn sometimes

mods.name: Gore/Hard-Mode!
mods.author: TheIncredibleHolc
mods.description:
Gore/Hard-Mode!
Category: Romhack
Difficulty: 10/10

Take a dive into the challenging world of Gore/Hard-Mode! Often called "Real life Mario 64", this mod originally started as a port of Kaze's Unfair Mario 64. It quickly grew into a cursed lovechild between Unfair Mario and 'I Wanna Be The Guy' sporting ridiculous obstacles and gory inspiration from both. Be prepared to die numerous times in unexpected ways!

Features:

120 completely obtainable stars. (Some speed-run tactics may be needed!)
20 collectable challenge trophies with a special prize if you unlock them all. (Trophy hunt starts after 50 stars collected.)
Player behavior overhaul. Prepare for Splats, crunches, chomps, and many new ways to die!
All existing vanilla enemies now have new and upgraded behaviors.
Some levels have been modified for extra difficulty! (Can be disabled by using Romhack Compatibility mode)
Entirely original secret boss fight.
"I Wanna Be The Guy Mode" - Plays identical to the mod, but you start at zero stars. On death, all progress (Stars, keys, flags) are all reset back to 0... Current record is 21 stars!
Togglable options for in the Mod Menu. (Romhack Compatibility, Enable Hell on Game-over, Enable PVP deaths, Enable IWBTG Mode, Enable Dizzyness.)
Compatible with Rom-hacks, Arena, Flood, and more! (Enable Rom-hack Compatibility mode if needed.)

Gore Team
Incredible Holc - Project Lead.
@Cooliokid 956  - Major technical contributor that kept this project going and brought the toughest ideas into existence!
@Blocky  - Major technical work, enemy behavior contributor, lots of other things including the secret final boss!
@birdekek  - Contributor, built out a lot of the custom Hell level, added the "blood mist" when Mario dies.
Tilly - Contributor, created AMAZING models for the secret room trophies and the trophy hunt prize ;)
@saniky - Contributor, created all of the GORE character models, including bitten_in_half and decapitated character models.
@Sharen64 - Creator of the Inertia mod, approved using in Gore mods.
@MetalKingBoo - Creator of the character screaming sounds. Check out his YT! [www.youtube.com/@Metalkingboo]
SaMiX - Creator of the Ultimate Bowser Remix used in the final fight. Check it out here! [SaMiX]

Special thanks to other Gore contributors: Isaac, Frijoles, ProfeJavix, I'mYourCat, Chilly, and the Coop Community!

mods.name: Easy Custom Moveset
mods.author: srGSR
mods.description:
Easy Custom Movesets
This mod allows anyone to add unique movesets to any character, no coding required. Just fill out the forms at ECM Form Website, and in less than 5 minutes, your character with new moves.

Also, it comes pre-configured with over 100 modded characters, so you can start playing immediately without any manual setup!


* the character and custom animation are from other mods, check "Mods Integrated" section to see who made then.


Adding/Editing Moveset 

Access ECM Form Website
Fill the name field, it should be the same as in Chracter Select menu
Configure the rest of the options for your character
Download the generated Lua config file without renaming the file
Place the file in mods/Easy-Custom-Movesets/moveset_configs folder
Enable Chracter Select, Easy Custom Moveset and your Character mod in-game
Select your character and play!


Integrating your mod
Inside your main.lua, after _G.charSelect.character_add ,  execute _G.customMoves.character_add to change the character stats.


-- Default Character Select Code
_G.charSelect.character_add(
    "Custom Model",
    {"Custom Model Description", "Custom Model Description"},
    "Custom Model Creator",
    {r = 255, g = 200, b = 200},
    E_MODEL_CUSTOM_MODEL,
    CT_MARIO,
    get_texture_info("custom-icon")
)

-- Modify character stats if customMoves exists
if _G.customMovesExists then
    _G.customMoves.character_add({
        name = "Custom Model",
        swimming_speed = 500
    })
end


For example, to add support to the Iono character mod, I added line 61-63 to the Iono main.lua Here .

This mod contains flashing lights or patterns that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised.

Original Mod Author: Kaze Emanuar
Coop Mod Author: ManIsCat2

Not all the codes (effects) could be ported for coop because of limitations so some are missing. I am deeply sorry!

This mod has a mod menu, the host can modify the Chaoticness and the Chaos Timer, here's what they do:
    - Chaoticness: Max amount of codes (effects) that can be active at once.
    - Chaos Timer: The time between code activation (seconds).

Some info about the mod:
    - Do not report any Bugs to Mods or the actual game while playing this Mod!!!
    - Also remember that this mod can cause lag!!!
    - in this mod, the object effects only sync if the player that has activated the effect and you, are in the same level.
    - If you experience Script Errors, ping me in Coop Central or DM me in Discord. (username is maniscat2)

mods.name: SM64CoopDX Manager
mods.author: Squishy6094
mods.description:
SM64CoopDX Manager
A tool made for managing SM64CoopDX and it's mods



How to use:
SM64CoopDX Manager attempts to be as user friendly as possible for a console-based manager, but there are some caviates...

Getting Dependancies:

System - Must be installed on your machine manually in order to use basic Python functionality

Python - The language SM64CoopDX Manager is built in
pip - Package installer for Python

Python Libraries - Must be installed in order to use SM64CoopDX Manager, if pip is installed you can use these commands in your terminal of choice to download them manually.

requests - python -m pip install requests
chime - python -m pip install chime
watchdog - python -m pip install watchdog



Starting the program:
After installing all of the required dependancies, you should be able to launch the python file in the same way you would an executible file. Once starting, it will attempt to download the Python Libraries above automatically if you haven't already, then you will boot into the Manager Menu!

Goals:
1. (Achieved) A User-Friendly console-based mod organizer made to improve Loading / Mod Cache times
2. (Future Update) An Automatic SM64CoopDX Update Notifier and Installer

Current Functionality:
1. Mod Organization
2. Mass Mod Loading / Unloading
3. Automatic Mod Backups
4. Improved Mod Caching Times (Dependant on Mods loaded)
5. Booting SM64CoopDX from Launcher
6. Automatic Python Package Instalation

Planned Functionality:
1. Automatic SM64CoopDX Update Installation
2. (?) Automatic Mod Update Installation
3. (?) DynOS Organization
4. (?) SM64CoopDX Config Editor/Option Menu

mods.name: [CS] Grey Man

mods.description:
In the year 1998, a strange and unique little game named LSD: Dream Emulator came out on the PS1 only in Japan, based on a dream journal and the bizarre experiences chronicled within. Despite how locally-restricted its release was and how niche its focus, as well as frankly being clunky as all hell mechanically, it still ended up becoming a cult classic of sorts, including one particular rare entity found within gaining notoriety of its own; 

The Grey Man, one of the few truly-dangerous things you could come across on your dream journeys. One which ignored all obstacles to make its way forward slowly and menacingly, ending your dream instantly if you make contact. A total enigma, beyond the fact that it was as strange as it was scary.

Anyways, that's enough gaming history and mysteries, now you get to watch this spooky entity do sick jumps and fly around with wings on his hat while making funny noises. Plus, he's finally in a game with decent FPS and controls by default.







Features:



Complete custom palette recolorability, including a bonus when hat is removed


Full custom hat model set (including hat removal for vulture/monkey/OMM/etc.)


Custom lives icon, as is tradition


An entire set of sounds cut from SFX and audio snippets used in LSD itself, mainly the base audio clips that the strange randomized music in-game is built out of, so GM's "voice" is basically the music of the game in a sense


Integration with the "Character Movesets" mod, GM uses the Waluigi moveset and can double-jump, swim in the air by diving mid-air multiple times and takes extra damage from hits (can be changed easily with one simple edit in the main.lua file, the zip includes a readme with info on how)


Maybe some slight jank here and there (did my best to avoid it though)






Credits:

TheVGResource - Models, Textures and Audio

"LSD Dreamy Texture Pack" by BTL Games on itch.io - The image used for the lives icon, specifically "8.png" from the "faces" folder, downscaled to 64x from 1024x original

I'mYourCat on the CoopDX discord server - Helping me fix yet another annoying metal material bug that was preventing export in blender, by taking a look at my blend file and telling me what workaround I needed to do to fix it

mods.name: Learn To Make Code mods Resources and Tutorials
mods.author: Q10isarobot
mods.description:
Do you want to make Code mods and don't know where to start? Start here!!!
This mod contains many useful code resources that are easy for a beginner to understand and use.

I have also made a tutorial (featured below)  and more are planned to come.
this mod contains SEVERAL code mods in one folder, they are meant to be used as starting points for you to make your own mods

RESOURCES:


HoldLtoenterPU.lua = this is the mod that is made in my tutorial video, hold L to multiply players current speed * 2.
this will allow you so much speed that you can clip into parallel universes.

PlayerSizeControl.lua = press dpad up or down to make player bigger or smaller, press Y to return to 0

PressLtoResetinStartMenu = while the game is paused, press L to reset players position to the start of the level. this is a conveniant way to prevent softlock. ROMHACK MAKERS: you can copy this code into the main.lua file in your romhack, this is great for testing maps or just keeping players from getting softlocked.

PressUptoSpawnRandomEnemy.lua = press the up button to spawn a random enemy near the player

Simpletimer.lua = a timer that counts up every second as you play

CyclethroughActions.lua = view all of the actions in the game (minus some that would cause softlock)

Cyclethroughmodels.lua = view all of the 3d Models in the game (minus some that dont show up)

Soundtest.lua = test all sounds from the game (minus some that are silent)

Bigmario Example.lua = an example of mini mario and Mega mario powerups

SpawnanevilSmiley.lua = an simple example of a custom Enemy




TUTORIAL:



LINKS:
Hooks List
Mario State
Constants
More Examples
Player Sounds


PERMISSION
all of the code in this mod is free to use in your mods no credit.
this is a resource to use as a starting point to make your own mods

But since not everyone knows this, here's a mod I made in like 10 minutes that does it for you. mods.name: CMDLib (Command Library)
mods.author: kloodi
mods.description:
CMDLib is a command library that helps other mods make commands easier.

There are lots of features including:
Adding Commands
Editing Commands (Not just the description)
Removing Commands
Automatic Argument Parsing
Error Handling

CMDLib commands are prefixed with "!" rather than "/" (For no interfering with sm64coopdx commands)

There are two commands by default that you cannot edit or remove.
!help and !helpcmd, Which give a list of commands and a long description of a specific command respectively.

Charged Y (hold until the bar is charged): Boost Shoot
Ground Pound + Y: Ground Pound Shoot
Ground Pound + Charged Y: Boost Ground Pound Shoot
X: Toggle First Person


You can use the shotgun either in PvP or with some game objects/enemies, the choice is yours (tip: each move deals different damage, so not all of them will have an effect on some targets). 

Check Mod Menu to set the reload time and the boost charge time. Also, if you load EmilyEmmi's MarioHunt, the host will have the chat command "/sgcoop-mhteam" to select which team will have the shotguns. Allowed values are:

"0" or "hunters" ( default)
"1" or "runners"
"2" or "both"


Credits to Agent X's Gun Mod for the PvP inspiration and Dorrieal's Shotgun Mario romhack for the original shotgun concept.

There's a Randomized Mode, where powerups are unknown, so you'll never know which one you will pick until you grab it. Good luck...

mods.name: [CS] Martlet
mods.author: Micharus
mods.description:
Snowdin's former Royal Guard, reporting in.
Or sleeping in.
One of the two.
Martlet from Undertale Yellow is now playable in SM64 COOPDX!
This character mod includes:

Recolorability!
Custom voice lines by Ciozio!
Custom Cap in the form of the Royal Guard Guidebook!
Custom Lives and Stars icons, Power Meter, and Celebration Star!
Custom animations!
Custom moveset!
The odd feeling that she fits into this game a little TOO well!

Think about it!

And maybe more to come...?


Moveset Details

The power of flight! Martlet can fly without the need of a Wing Cap by pressing A in midair during a Triple Jump (or, of course, by using a cannon), but watch your Stamina Meter!

She gets five seconds of flight time without the Cap, and afterwards she starts falling like a... well, if you know, you know. Touching the ground, splashing into deep water, or using a cannon will fully restore Stamina, grabbing onto a pole in midair restores one second, and grabbing a coin restores half a second!
Pitching down won't speed you up much, and pitching up is... not recommended.
If you have some Stamina left, dive during a midair Ground Pound by pressing B. At the cost of one second, you can trigger flight again! Use this to get extra height or reach, or to easily change directions! Also, press A during any dive to trigger flight as well!
Press A during a midair Ground Pound to Long Jump instead! This risky move costs two seconds and is technically against safety protocol, but with good timing, you can use it to Wall Kick! Just remember: you can't Ground Pound during a Long Jump! Make sure it's worth the risk!
If you bonk into a wall while flying, hold A to flutter and slow your descent just like you would with the Wing Cap! This won't work if you're Long Jumping, though!
Triple Jump out of Ground Pounds by pressing A upon landing!

Martlet can fly ANYWHERE with the Wing Cap! Forget about air traffic control, no-fly zones, and Stamina Meters, the sky is YOURS! Pitch up as high as you want! Pitch down to go as fast as you want! This bird's gotta fly!

Be sure to follow safety protocol by pressing A to brake when necessary!
You'll keep flying if the Wing Cap wears off, but you'll have only three seconds of Stamina left. Get to a safe place to land!

Check out Martlet's special attacks!

The Feather Whirl replaces punching and kicking. When used in midair, it can also be used as a double jump!
The Feather Dive and Feather Slide enhance Martlet's dive and slide kick, allowing her to slip past certain damaging effects. They also boost her speed a bit more!
The Feather Pound enhances Martlet's ground pound. Just before ground pounding, hold Z down to activate it. If you tap Z instead, Martlet will ground pound faster than usual!
The Junk Punt replaces the trip kick. Martlet kicks some random junk at a nearby available target. You know how it is!

Rumor has it that someone who shares vague similarities to Martlet may grant her something a bit better this time.


Additional Credits:

Team UTY (Character)
Emmalume (Design)
Ciozio (Voice Acting)
ZenderTroop (Additional Assistance, Humoring Me)
Kody (Bob-Omb Protocol)

Make sure you have Character Select Version 1.16.3 in order to use this mod!

As many can tell, it's inspired by UT's Facing Worlds, but it's not a 1:1 recreation. mods.author: Pipocalio
mods.description:
This mod adds a mirror mode to Super Mario 64, flipping the entire game world horizontally — including levels, objects, and animations.

Since it doesn't replace any geometry, so it should work with most custom levels and "romhacks" without issues.
Note that this mod only flips the camera controls if you're using the vanilla camera. If you're using a custom one (romhack camera, analog camera, mouse look), you might want to manually enable "Flip X axis" in your camera settings.

Also, shoutouts to ManIsCat for helping me fix some rendering issues!

mods.name: [CS] Doorway Divers (FavChars)
mods.author: Fav
mods.description:
Dummie, Frank, Huggert, and Panella have come to invade Super Mario 64!
Who said modding in your OCs wasn't fun?


Dummie has two extra jumps he can use at (almost) any time! From your base jump, to side flips, to even long jumps! He even has a faster running speed!

(Fun note: Wall kicks replenish your extra jumps!)
As a bonus, if you happen to have your wing cap on or activated the special triple jump, the last jump will change! Pull off some sick tricks with this!




As Frank, you can fly around by double jumping for a short amount of time before he gets tired. If you hold jump again while flying, Frank will burst upward, and hover back down until you let go of the button. Use the second jump to thrust yourself based on your directional input!



Huggert's a lot slower than the rest, but makes up for it with his lower gravity. If you hold jump again after your first jump, Huggert will use the power of the stars to float upward, and slowly descend back down. Great for long falls downward!



Panella's a lot stronger than the rest, capable of carrying objects easier, no matter the weight. If you ground pound and press A or B at the right time, Panella will either perform a Super Jump, or a Super Kick. Your directional input will influence where she'll go!


I hope you enjoy this mod as much as I did making it!




Credits:

Garrulous64 - Mario 64 Modding Tutorial Video
CoopDX team - Referenced code from the built-in Extra Characters mod to better understand how movesets are structured
Dummie - For being a good boy

mods.author: SwagSkeleton95
mods.description:
The secret boss from chapter 4 busts his way into Mario 64!

Originally just a model swap mod, coding help from Baconator2558 (Youtube) and @Kaktus64 (Bluesky) with voice acting from Starwarrior64 (Twitter, Youtube) it's become something a bit more than that.

THIS MOD FEATURES:

Full recolorability
Custom UI graphics
Bowser moveset compatibility (Shell slide)
Voice acting (Toggle between voice acted lines and game sounds!)
A brand new moveset integrating the TP bar mechanic from the original game
A tough-as-nails challenge mode that forces you to use your moveset against Bowser in a deadly game of tennis
Optional alternate skyboxes for the bowser levels
A small example mod to show how you can use the moveset's TP bar or rude buster in your own mod (Lancer approved!)

Be sure to check the mod menu to toggle most of these options!

MOVESET
While Gerson uses the standard moveset, using the Hammer Of Justice costume will give you access to a special moveset consisting of 4 new moves.

Hammer Spin: Press Z + A mid-air to bounce yourself into a powerful hammer spin! Great for movement, good for crushing enemies. Costs 6 TP to use.

Shell Groundpound: Performing a ground pound with enough TP will send two koopa shells from your sides! Good for taking out small groups of enemies. Costs 1 TP to use.

Dive Roll: Holding Z after a dive lets Gerson roll to keep his momentum and extend the slide.

Justice Buster: Press Z + B to unleash your most powerful attack: the mighty Justice Buster! This attack costs 33 TP to use, but is very powerful against most enemies. The projectile will home in on any nearby targets and swiftly strike them down. This move is necessary against Bowser in the challenge mode!

REQUIRES WIBBLUS' BOWSER MOVESET - Shell slide: Shell slide from the Bowser Moveset. Replaces the slide kick.

TP BAR
The moveset's main feature is the new TP bar, which is used to perform Gerson's special moves. TP is spent by using moveset moves, but can be regained by collecting coins, defeating enemies, collecting stars, swinging Bowser by the tail or entering new levels. Or, if you would prefer, the mod provides a (host-exclusive) option to regenerate TP automatically at a quick rate, allowing you to use your moves as much as you please.

LANCER
Huh- Lancer?
The mod comes with a small example mod featuring Lancer. Open it up to get an example of how to use this mod's TP bar and rude buster for your own characters! This will require the Gerson Boom mod as a dependency.

mods.name: Escape Sequence
mods.author: Pseudonym929
mods.description:
Escape Sequence

This is a gameplay mod that adds a timed escape sequence after a player collects a star, similar to how levels work in Wario Land 4 and Pizza Tower.



During the escape sequence, the player must return to a portal located at spawn. The time limit is based on the player's proximity to the portal when they collect the star. If the timer runs out, the player will die and the star won't be counted.

This mod is somewhat compatible with custom levels, though isn't guaranteed to work for every star. By default the sequence is disabled in levels and areas where the player cannot return to spawn in vanilla, though these settings can be adjusted through chat commands.

How the Timer Works:
The timer uses multiple variables (italicized below) which can be adjusted by the server owner through chat commands. The formula for determining how much time you are given is as follows:

base timer value * (player's distance from spawn on the xz-plane / zero-radius) ^ xz-exponent + player's distance from the portal on the y-axis / y-units-per-second * 30

Base timer value can be modified with the chat command "/basetime"
Zero-radius can be modified with the chat command "/zeroradius"
XZ-exponent can be modified with the chat command "/xzpower"
Y-units-per-second uses different values for when the player is above the portal versus when they are beneath it. The value for when the player is above can be modified with the chat command "/fallratio", while the value for when the player is beneath can be modified with the chat command "/climbratio"
All players can also change the sound that plays after they collect a star with the chat command "/warnsnd"

Ever wanted Super Mario World's Mario playable in Super Mario 64? well, i do, thats why i made:
Super Mario World in Super Mario 64! [CS]




that's right! Super Mario World!
he is not just a simple reskin, he has Moveset! with it A LOT of custom actions!

since he is SMW Mario he can't do Mario's Default actions like punching or walljumping (that could be a problem with some parkour challenges... but feel free to switch to normal Mario any times!).

About his Moves:   


A to Jump - Press A to jump, simpler than that! he has only one jump, no double jumps or triple jumps. like in the original game: Hold The Jump Button to Jump Higher or Build up Speed to Jump even more!



B to Run - Hold the B Button to Run, He can get fast! maybe you manage to Jump over most of the difficult places like that.



Y to Spinjump - Spinjump! one of the most known actions from the SNES the spinjump! you can spinjump on most enemies! some will get defeated and do Poof! others will get no damage so be careful!   you can also SpinJump on objects that need Groun Pound to be used, like the big Blue Coins Button!



X to Hold Objects - (is possible to use B to grab objects by enabling it in the mod menu) Since it could be done, the X Button is used to grab objects like boxes or bob-ombs, Remember that like the original game you have to Hold Down the X button to keep holding the object and Release it to throw it! It also works with Bosses such as Bowser!



Z to Crouch - Press Z to Crouch, Mario will not be abile to move when crouched, but if you move before crouching you will slide on the ground for a bit, allowing you to sneak in small places!



Objects and Interactions - Mario is also abile to interact with most objects: Open Doors By walking into them or Grab on Poles by jumping on them and press Up and Down to go Up and Down.



Water Movement - When in water, Mario can Swim By pressing A. you can also Grab objects while underwater too!



Others - it may happens you get hurt, if you get at 4 Health Points you will get SMALL! right after playng the shrinking animation. But dont worry! Collect Coins To Heal your Health!and you will return BIG again. there are also Winning and Dieing animations, be sure to check them out!


While Jumping around the levels, you may notice some Slope Blocks run on them to Climb the Wall and get on top of places! (i placed them for you <3) (Thanks to ManIsCat for the slopes blocks code!)


- Stuff you may want to know

- Is this mod done?

this is a "Demo" Release because i was taking long to make this. in the future Expect some Changes! Like Power ups! from the game!

- Is Mario Recolorable?

yes, i added an alt Recolorable Costume (is an alt because i couldn't make it Palette Accurate) use that in case you want to use custom palettes!
is an ALT COSTUME accessed by pressing right in the cs menu (saying this because apparently people didn't notice)

- Does it works online?

this works online! i fixed most of the networking bugs, but don't expect to not find them! (report the non-online bugs too!)

- Does it have mod support?

it should work with most of the mods, don't expect it to work with all mods! 


THIS MOD ONLY WORKS IF CHARACTER SELECT IS ENABLED!
SMW Mario Can be choosen from the CS Menu
Be sure you are using the latest version!



don't expect this mod to do not have bugs or being accurate to the SNES!

This should be all! Thanks for reading and playng my mod! :D
(Thanks again to ManIsCat for the Slopes Blocks code and Altiami and other people from Coop Central Discord server!)

mods.name: Star Revenge 8: Scepter of Hope
mods.author: SamCardCounter
mods.description:
Star Revenge 8: Scepter of Hope

About:

121 stars
Open world
Levels themed around various locations of the Touhou Project series
Star Revenge series


This is Star Revenge 8, a full-size hack featuring a world of interconnected levels and branching paths, all based on Touhou Project. Collect stars, cap switches, and returning badges from Star Revenge 7 in order to traverse Gensokyo and the realms that connect to it.

Story: After the events of Star Revenge 7.5, the Earth was hopelessly pulverized, and the mysterious big star Scriosadh has taken hold of the Scepter of Faith lingering in the planet's remains, shaping the world into it's image: a dark void.
Now, Mario, after being brought back from the dead by mistake, must explore the still-intact Gensokyo in search of stars to defeat Scriosadh and recharge the Scepter to reshape the Earth once more; either for better or for worse.

Other notes:

Navigation map included inside the zip.
This port uses v1.4.3 of the romhack.
Music sequences, instead, are ported from the v1.0, since the sequences featured in the newest versions utilize custom soundbanks, an impossible task for SM64CoopDx yet.
By default, the jingles for both collecting a star and the following hi-score play instead a full, looping music track. You can change this back to a simple, modern jingle by using the comand /newJingle [on/off].
With the command /sr8mode [pointdevice/legacy] or [0/1] you can change between two gamemodes. Pointdevice mode is the default, with infinite lives, 1ups are replaced with full heal items and there is no fall damage. Legacy mode changes it back to traditional lives and fall damage.
This romhack, among it's levels, features 2 challenging extra stages. They can only be accessed after inputing a password in a room near of the starting point of the hack. Where is this password? You can find it by either playing Star Revenge 6.9 or defeating the final boss of this hack.
This hack will not work properly in versions of SM64CoopDx below v1.3 (preferably the latest, scrolling textures were re-broken until 1.3.1!).
There was an attempt at reimplementing jukeboxes back from the More Objects Patch.


Star Revenge Lore Order:
SR0 ➜ SR1.5 ➜ SR2 TTM ➜ SR2.5 ➜ SR3.5 ➜ SR3.9 ➜ SR4.5 ➜ SR4.9 ➜ SR6.25 ➜ SR6.5 ➜ SR6.9 ➜ SR5 ➜ SR7 ➜ SR7.5 ➜ SR8 ➜ SR5.5 ➜ SRX

Rocket (+1 rocket)
Plasma Cell (+20 plasma)
Fuel Can (+10 fuel)
Berserk

provides full heal
remains active until player exits area (red haze is just a visual effect)

Backpack (+10 bullets, +4 shells, + 1 rocket, +20 plasma, +10 fuel)

doubles ammo capacity (1 time only)

+1 Secret item per area

Commands:

/unmaker (true/false): Toggles Unmaker and Demon Key spawns (server owner only)
/lor (on/off/mix): Toggles Incinerator, Calamity Blade, and fuel spawns. "on" causes them to replace the plasma weapons (plasma cells will remain if Unmaker is enabled), "mix" enables spawning of all weapons and ammo types (server owner only)
/vertspread (true/false): Toggles vertical spread for the shotgun and chaingun (server owner only)
/msglimit (0 - 99): Maximum number of pickup messages 
/msgtime (0-600): # of Seconds a pickup message will remain on screen
/altitemnames (true/false): changes the names of certain items to be more technically accurate (in case that kind of thing bothers you)
/maxitems (any nonnegative integer): changes the maximum number of items that can appear in an area, useful if you're playing a romhack with big levels (server owner only)
/spawns base (any nonnegative integer): changes the number of weapons that spawn in an area at 0 stars (server owner only)
/spawns starbonus (any positive integer): changes how many stars the player(s) need to have for an extra weapon spawn, to disable, set to an unreachably high number (server owner only)
/spawns secret (any nonnegative integer): changes the number of secrets that spawns in an area (server owner only)
/intermission (doom, doom2, doom64, off): changes or disables the intermission screen
/pistolstart (true/false): Toggles Pistol Start. Players will start every level with just a pistol and fists (server owner only)
+4 cheats from the original games (server owner only)

Note: This has not been extensively tested in multiplayer. Bugs are likely to occur.

mods.name: Bowser's Koopalings Character Pack
mods.author: BassiKun
mods.description:
With this character pack I bring you the ability to play as a set of characters from Bowser's Koopalings, a Koopalings fan-series on YouTube created by FreezeFlame22! The characters are also all voiced by their voice actors from the show! (Except for one, who instead uses voice clips from the episodes)

To install it, simply place the "[CS] Bowser's Koopalings Character Pack" file into your "mods" folder. The Characters all use the Bowser Moveset mod, so make sure to have that installed, as well as the latest version of Character Select.


Special thanks to:

wibblus and melzinoff for giving me access and permission to use the Koopalings and Bowser Jr. character bases to make these characters. I really couldn't have done this without them!
All the voice actors who helped me make this mod a reality. You all rock!
My friends over at Discord for encouraging me to learn Blender to make this dream come true. If you guys are reading this, thank you from the bottom of my heart!
Cowabunga and FreezeFlame22 himself over on Discord for the sprites used both in the image below and in the character icons found in the mod itself.
The people at the Coop Central server for helping me whenever I had doubts with Blender. Thanks to them, I have improved a bit with the program!


This mod includes the following characters:

Travis Koopa (VA: GengarOfTheOpera):



A chill guy with a very laid-back attitude, Travis comes into Super Mario 64 to both save the day while taking it all easy.
Lauren Knightley (VA: GlitterGhostz)




A nice and friendly, if a bit sarcastic girl. She's an avid gamer and is not afraid of demonstrating her skills!
Ally Rook (VA: Carmen)

Ally is a very sweet girl who, in spite of her ditziness, does everything in her power to support the ones she loves.
Camilla McQueen (VA: Carmen)


A vain and selfish girl from the McQueen family. When Camilla wants something, she will do anything in her power to get it.

Ember Ford (VA: YuriHaru567) 


A girl who is as brash and condescending as she is hot-headed. Ember looks down on everyone else and never passes up an opportunity if it means ridiculing others.
Jade Garnet (VA: GlitterGhostz)

A very mischevious and self-centered girl, Jade finds a lot of amusement in the misfortunes of other people.
Eddie Knightley (Voice Clips: Swoldow)

Lauren's older brother. He is short-tempred and rather brash, but he is genuinely a good guy underneath that tough exterior.

Known Issues:

When going into Shell Mode, the shadow size doesn't match the shell. This is something I will try to fix in the future as I eventually figure out how to adjust shadow sizes.
Hair often clips through the female characters' shells. This is something I was struggling with due to how little experience in Blender I had. I ultimately decided to leave it as it is, but I may try to fix it in the future.

mods.name: (MH) Secret Helpers
mods.author: ProfeJavix
mods.description:
In this MarioHunt extension, you can give some players the role of "Helper," which makes them invisible and gives them the purpose of trolling the opposing team.
Important: You must load MarioHunt with this mod!

Use:
To make a player a Helper, the host must type the corresponding command and select the desired player. This player will then become a helper for their current team until the host removes that role (or, in the case of Runners, until all non-helpers are eliminated and the Hunters win). It is recommended that this assignment take place before the match begins. Helpers can't collect stars, coins, keys nor grab things, so go melee!

Chat command:

/sh-toggle : toggles the Helper Selector menu (only for host)

Mod Menu Options:

Rival helpers can see each other: Allow helpers from a team see the helpers of the other one and viceversa
Runner helpers can exit level anytime: Remove the level exit restriction from MH on Helpers


Original mod idea by Drenchy. Check out his video:

mods.name: (MH) Control Hunters
mods.author: ProfeJavix
mods.description:
Important: MarioHunt must be loaded to use this mod

In this MH extension, runners will have a menu from which they can select and control a player from the opposing team. After selecting a hunter, the runner will control them for a period of time while the hunter spectates helplessly. When the time is up, the runner will return to their original position. But beware, if the controlled hunter dies, the runner will also die!

Mod Menu Options:

Control Seconds (5-60 seconds): set the period of time in which the runner can control the hunter.
Cooldown Seconds (0-30 seconds): set the cooldown in which the runner will have to wait to control a hunter again


Original mod idea by Drenchy. Check out his video:

mods.name: Bingo Coop
mods.author: ProfeJavix
mods.description:
In this mod, a 5x5 table will be generated when the match starts. Each cell will contain a different task, which can be from collecting a star in a specific level to kill a certain boss or player. When a player completes a cell, it becomes failed for the rivals.  Every player must try to make a row (horizontal,  vertical or diagonal) or, if not possible, get the highest amount of completed cells to win the match.

Gamemodes

Free For All - Every player completes his own tasks.
Teams Mode - The tasks progress is shared for the whole team.
MarioHunt (only if MH is loaded) - The match starts and ends with the MH match, and Runners complete tasks while Hunters try to get in their way.


Chat Commands

/bingo-team [red | blue] select the team you wanna join.
/bingo-start start a Bingo match (host only)
/bingo-stop stops the current Bingo match if any (host only)
/bingo-mode [ffa | team] set the Bingo gamemode (host only)

This commands are only available if MH is NOT loaded.

Mod Menu Options

Show Table Controls toggle on-screen Bingo table controls.
Give Buffs On Cell Completion toggle if certain cells give buffs. This cells will have a tiny red star on the corner (host only and if MH not loaded)
Buff Seconds [10s-90s] the duration in seconds of the cell buffs (host only and if MH not loaded)

Mario Size lets you shrink or grow Mario on the fly, changing how he moves around!

Grow Mode:

Controls: Press Y twice, hold on the second press

mods.name: Only Up 64 Plugin
mods.author: DizzyThermal
mods.description:
Only Up 64 Plugin (sm64coopdx)

This is NOT the Only Up 64 Map

Plugin Features


Warp System (Disabled by Default)


To enable the warp system, the host or moderator must type: /ou64-warps

With warps enabled, type: /ou64-practice or use keybind: [X]

Toggle Height (Y-Coordinate) on HUD / Player list:

/ou64-height - Toggles Character height on HUD and Player List.



Ground Pound Twirl (A, Z, A)

Rollout after twirl is to not allow consecutive ground pound twirls



Ground Pound Jump (A, Z, A on ground)

Triple front flip animation instead of jump twirl



Ground Pound Dive (A, Z, B)


Wallslide

Allows wallslide from long jump



Instant-Turn

Allows for the player to make 180-degree turns when moving slow enough


Chat Commands

/ou64-height - Toggles Character height on HUD and Player List


/ou64-meter - Toggles Height Meter


/ou64-moveset - Toggles Only Up 64 Moveset


/ou64-checkpoints - Toggles Checkpointing [Mod Only]


/ou64-warps - Toggles Warps [Mod Only]


/ou64-practice - Shows Warp Menu (Must be Enabled)


/ou64-run-timer - Toggles Run Timer


/ou64-leaderboard - Toggles Leaderboard


Changes

Added Leaderboard and Run Timer
Added / Refactored Chat Commands
Added Checkpoints - modified to work in different areas (thanks djoslin0!)
Added exportable server metrics
Refactored a lot of the code
Added Warp Menu for Practice
Added Flood Mod Support
Added Area 8 and made the plugin compatible with all versions of Only Up 64
Added Debug Warp system from Only Up 64 Alpha testing to Only Up 64 Plugin (Default Off)
Being able to change directions when ground pound diving
Using the triple jump action for the ground pound jump (removed original ground pound jump)
Sparkles on frame-perfect dive rollouts, wallkicks, and speed kicks.
Less jank and higher gravity on the wall slide.
Merging changes from the Only Up 64 Alpha Tests
Decreased Ground Pound Twirl Y-Boost (42.0 -> 40.0)
Decreased Ground Pound Twirl Count (20 -> 10)
Allow Wallslide after Long Jump (Like Only Up 64)


Known Issues

Ground Pound Twirl ends in a ACT_FORWARD_ROLLOUT to make sure you cannot ground pound consecutively. This means Mario does a frontflip before entering free fall.


Credits

Ground Pound Jump, Ground Pound Dive, and Wallslide are from mods/extended-moveset.lua with some modifications
Moveset contributors: @steven3004
Checkpoints: @djoslin0
Recolored player heads: @EmilyEmmi
sm64coopdx technical help: @cooliokid956, @andre8739
Testing help: @retrodarkgamerx, @cooliokid956, @colbyrayz.z64

mods.name: Only Up 64
mods.author: DizzyThermal
mods.description:
Only Up 64 (sm64coopdx)


About

Only Up 64 is a romhack created by Kaze and thelegendofzenia

This whole mod is one big, tall level that takes around 25 minutes to complete - if you don't fall. Climb the biggest level ever made! (as of today)

You can use the GP dive and the GP spin to have an easier time in this game but difficult mode is doing it without them!

Mod Description

This mod is just the Only Up 64 map and original music.

Nothing else is required to feel the pain, but if you want the moveset and more goodies, keep reading.

Only Up 64 Plugin

The Only Up 64 Plugin (sm64coopdx) provides the following features:

Only Up 64 Moveset:

Ground Pound Twirl (A, Z, A)
Ground Pound Jump (A, Z, A on ground)
Ground Pound Dive (A, Z, B)
Instant-Turn
Wallslide

Character Heights on HUD and Playerlist
Warp System
Leaderboard / Run Timer
Exportable Server Metrics (Used for Dizzy's Abyss)

Playerlist
Server Start Time
Server Heartbeat


Please make sure all mods are on the latest version for the best experience!

Only Up 64 Flood Mod


Flood Mod Support for Only Up 64.


Flood Mod is a game mode by Agent X - Climb to the top as the area floods!

Chat Commands


/ou64-music - Toggles Only Up 64 Original Soundtrack

Known Issues

Warps can rotate camera for non-free camera


Only Up 64 Map Blender File

This mod wouldn't be possible without Kaze releasing the Blender file for the map. Here is my modified one for sm64coopdx: Only Up 64 Blender File

The Blender map was recently optimized by going through each object and removing unused textures. The file size has been reduced from 536.5 MB to 186.4 MB!

Only Up 64 Mario Blender File

The Mario model wouldn't be possible without Kaze. Thank you Kaze for permission to use it in this mod: Modified Mario Blender File

Thank you SonicTheHedgeHog64 (originally known as ThePerfectMario64) for post-processing the textures to work correctly.
Warning

Must use Blender 3.2+ with latest Fast64-Gart Edition - NOT mainline fast64 or legacy fast64-coop

Changes


Added Star Model from original ROM Hack (thanks ColbyRayz, Kaze)
Added Mario model from Only Up 64 ROM Hack (thanks SonicTheHedgeHog64)
Fixed some bugged textures (e.g., Vaporeon's eyes, Kakuna's eyes, Koopa flag, end Mario)
Made end Mario recolor off of sm64coopdx part colors (i.e., cap, glove, etc - thanks SonicTheHedgeHog64 for painfully helping with this)


Credits


Kaze and thelegendofzenia for creating the original ROM Hack and giving permission to port the ROM hack and use the custom Mario model.
Cooliokid956 for helping with map backwarping, various other bits to make this all work, and dealing with my Python tendencies (nil not None!!).
SonicTheHedgeHog64 for post-processing the textures to work correctly in the end Mario and helping me with recoloring the end Mario.
ColbyRayz for tracking down map issues (without warping!) to help identify bugged textures and for getting permission and providing the Only Up 64 star model.
Soundtrack: MusicByAI - Only Up 64 OST: AI-Generated Chill Lofi Vibes.
Special thanks to everyone else on the sm64coopdx Discord who helped with testing and debugging this mod to make Only Up 64 possible!

(Logo by LJ_Retro)

(NOTE: I left "WIP" in the title by mistake in v1.2. Please ignore it, or change the title to remove it if you'd like.)

WarioWare-styled gameplay in Super Mario 64 Coop DX! React quickly to complete fast-paced microgames and go for the highest score you can! Work together in Coop mode, or go head-to-head in Versus or Team Versus mode. mods.author: Dgoki
mods.description:
What is this moveset?

Is a funky moveset, fully made by me.
It was made to be powerful while not removing things like the ability to BLJ from the player.
I was going to keep this private, however many people asked me to release it, over weeks and months.
I am 11 months late on my promise to release this, so i remastered it to make it more enjoyable.
I thought for a while no one cared about this anymore but i was wrong about that.
So i updated this moveset and improved it by a ton.

This moveset includes:

Speed modifier [PRESS Y TO SWITCH]  | (It includes 0,1x,0.5x,1.0x,1.3x,1.5x and 2.0x speed.)
Dir-Rotation   [PRESS X TO SWITCH]  | (Turn this off to BLJ or do similar things.)
Custom moves   [CAN BE DISABLED IN SETTINGS] | (Ground pound jump and dive, able to dive out of almost everything, able to quadruple jump, slide kick out of a dive with an A Press, etc.)

Here a list with all commands:

/dgm_help - Tells you basics about the moveset.
/dgm_moves - Tells you a list with the moves.
/dgm_reset - Reenters the level with full health. (good if you get stucked)
/dgm_version - Tells you the version. (Duh)


This is how the hud looks like:

Here a list with all the settings:






Special thanks to all the people that helped me test this goofy moveset.

mods.author: ProfeJavix
mods.description:
IMPORTANT: this mod needs Character Select to work


MOVESET

Normal Smash: press B to throw bouncing Thunderball. Can shock other players.
Up Smash: press Y to perform a Quick Dash to the stick direction. Press A to go up or Z to go down. Can be repeated instantly one time if the stick or the buttons are still held.
Down Smash: press X to cast a Thunder. Can be performed in air and shock-throws other players on hit.
Side Smash: hold B while ground pounding to charge a Skull Bash to the stick direction. The more charge, the more speed. Shock-throws other players on hit.


Moveset can be disabled via CharSelect options.

Original mod idea by Drenchy. Check out his video:


Check out Kog's showcase:
