mods.name: [CS] Wario Land 64
mods.author: SwagSkeleton95
mods.description:
Waah! It's been too long since the last brand new Wario Adventure! Maybe I should pick up the old treasure hunting sport again...This bounty for saving Princess Toadstool will do! What? This is supposed to be Mario's game?! Who cares!? Don't I deserve a little glory, too?? I'll just have to butt in and show how much better of a hero I truly am! No need to thank me, wahahaha! Now keep on reading to see what I have to offer!


Five Different Flavors of Wario!

I think I'll bring some of my best friends along for this adventure..! That's right, it's Me, and Me, and Me and Me and Me! This adventure lets you play as up to five of my beautiful selves! Play as the me from Land 3, 4, Shake it, Virtual Boy, and from my very first original game! If that isn't an amazing deal, I don't know what is, guhaha!


My Abilities!

My abilities are different from that lame show-off, Mario's! Enjoy playing as someone actually powerful for once! My shoulder-bash will easily take out any weak enemy that you hit with it, and it won't wait for any doors either! Wahahaha! Cool, huh? And that's not all of my awesome movement options, either! Bash, hold Z, and jump, and I'll do an awesome front flip! Let's see Mario do that!! Guhahaha! How about you find the rest yourself? My moves totally turn Mario's adventure upside down! Some things react differently to my abilities, so try to find every possible way to screw things up!


Get Stronger!
What, I'm still not tough enough for you!? You should have a little more respect! But your old pal Wario has you covered. Gather those shiny Power Star things to gain new, powerful versions of your abilities! How 'bout that? Take down multiple enemies with the Super Ground Pound! And not even Bowser will stand a chance against my Super Shoulder Bash!


Raise Your Rank!
Did you think this hero stuff was free!? No way! I deserve a little something too, you know? Those painting worlds are full of my favorite thing in the world: Coins. Help your pal Wario out and grab as many of them as you can! That Princess Toadstool had the right idea; I think I'll buy myself my own fancy castle with the money. I'll keep track of just how many you've found, and give you my personal, Wario-approved score at the end!


Find Treasure!
You'd better not think that strength is all you need to complete this adventure! Treasure hunting needs brains, too, you know!? And my brain is as smart as it gets. Each level has a valuable hidden gem somewhere in it, but you'll need to really explore to find some of them... I'm counting on you here! Each gem you find will multiply your ending score, so you can't miss out! There's sixteen gems in total, but...I thought there were only fifteen levels!?


Interact!
Sounds like everybody was expecting Mario! What, aren't they happy to see me instead!? All the friendly characters in the game will react differently to my awe-inspiring presence. Even the signs have re-written themselves to explain my controls instead!?
It doesn't stop at talking! I'll try bashing into someone to see if they have any goodies for me! It's a fair trade for saving their fancy princess, don't you think? Wahahaha!


What else do you want me to tell you!?

What are you waiting for, huh!? Aren't you convinced yet!? There's still more to discover in the adventure, but I won't just tell you everything. Go find out for yourself! And a great big thanks to the developers of this mod for bringing my dazzling self into this game!

And the playtesters!

mods.name: [CS] Gaby's Modding Frenzy
mods.author: Gabrimer
mods.description:
Welcome aboard, to my Modding Frenzy!



This mod project involves the idea I had at the beginning of the year, which was to make a year-long inspired project, adding multiple different sets of characters into SM64COOPDX! The character selection that I'm making is mostly either OCs I've made, or other characters from my friend's games/projects.
That being said, I understand this modpack might not interest most people, but I figured I'd share my work here, as I am happy with what I've made! (and it'd be nice seeing other people play with these characters)
 
I'm releasing each modpack on a monthly basis, with each pack having a certain theme to it, either being characters from a certain game, or characters from a similar origin/story. I'll be posting whenever I release a month's pack on my socials, then updating this mod page to include that pack!
It's worth noting that some packs won't be included in this mod page, for reasons such as an OC's author not wanting public access to these character mods, or anything related to the sort.
 
With that out of the way, let me introduce you to our character selection!
 
---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------
 
February - Aria Skies Character Pack



This month's pack is none other than the fighters from Aria Skies! As a way to celebrate the game's first anniversary, I decided to dedicate this month to the character pack.

Includes:

7 new characters (with custom Character Select graffiti and music track)

Red
Erika
Feng
Starre
Khaed
Wolske
Bilksem

Unique costumes for each character based on their different color palettes from the original game!


To view the other packs in more detail, head over to our updates tab! I had to remove each month from this front page because the description was getting too cluttered.

---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------

So far, this project includes the February, March, April, May and June modpacks (January was a private release between my friends and me), but as I mentioned previously, I'll be adding new characters each month, so be on the lookout for that!

Super Mario 64(2) is a hack created by FeYoshiParty that was made in Toad's Tool 64 back in 2007, making it one of the first and oldest hacks ever created. 

This hack was claimed to be lost for a very long time with footage seen only in youtube videos from the creator's channel, then a working build of the hack was uploaded to the Internet Archive in 2023. Which I later reuploaded to Romhacking.com with a patch fixing a few game breaking bugs made by myself, and now the hack has been ported to coop using that same patch.

The hack has 121 stars total. (122 if you can get the second star in Dire Dire Docks), it features retextured levels, edited object layouts, and this port also overrides the 5 Main Character palettes, changing them into a Fire Flower outfit seen in the original hack (thanks birdekek, for the help)

Have fun playing through a piece of romhacking history!

mods.author: funkymonkeyjay
mods.description:
DISCLAIMER
This mod will only work if you have the Character Select (v1.16 onwards, preferably v1.16.3) mod enabled + the current version of SM64 Co-op DX (v1.4 onwards, preferably v1.4.1).

Character Select [Squishy6094]




Play as the pink puffball warrior in SM64 Co-op DX with a moveset directly inspired by Kirby and the Forgotten Land (2022), made to fit within Kirby's N64 era!

This mod features:

Copy abilities in the form of the base game's power-ups, with Copy Ability Essences replacing the cap models!
Custom objects for the Air and Star bullets!
"Normal" and "Classic" costumes!
A host-only configuration that allows Kirby to puff up infinitely, perfect for ROM-hacks!
An API that allows modders to add objects for Kirby to inhale through LUA functions!


💫 Enjoy my work? Follow my socials! — Bluesky | YouTube | Bluesky (Gamedev) | YouTube (Gamedev) 💫

CONTROLS


BUTTONACTION


[ A ] (MIDAIR)Hover (Lasts temporarily, but can be configured by the host to last forever, suited for ROM-hacks)


[ B ]Inhale


[ Z ] + [ B ]Slide Kick


[ Z ] + [ CONTROL STICK ]Dodge


[ L ]Wave Hello


INHALE API
To hook a custom object for Kirby to inhale, or if you want to edit an existing object, you first need to have its behavior ID, once you've obtained it, you can proceed with adding these functions:
_G.kirbyInhaleHookBehavior
Allows the modder to hook a custom behavior for Kirby to inhale.
 


FIELDTYPENOTES


idinteger (BehaviorID)Behavior ID of the object to inhale.


canRotatebool / functionCheck to see if an object can rotate as its being inhaled, default is true.


canEatbool / functionCheck to see if an object can be removed once it reaches Kirby's mouth, default is true.


allowSuckFuncbool / functionSpecial checks for special objects (I.E. Koopa the Quick), set false to stop the inhale, default is true.


deleteOnDetectboolDeletes an object if it's within Kirby's inhale range, default is false, set true to activate.


onEatFuncfunction?Special function that activates once the object's been deleted (I.E. add to Big Bully #2's condition once a bully has been eaten), default is nil.


_G.kirbyInhaleEditBehavior
Allows the modder to edit an existing behavior for Kirby to inhale.
 


FIELDTYPENOTES


idinteger (BehaviorID)Behavior ID of the object to inhale.


canRotatebool? / function?Check to see if an object can rotate as its being inhaled, can be ignored.


canEatbool? / function?Check to see if an object can be removed once it reaches Kirby's mouth, can be ignored.


allowSuckFuncbool? / function?Special checks for special objects (I.E. Koopa the Quick), can be ignored.


deleteOnDetectbool?Deletes an object if it's within Kirby's inhale range, can be ignored.


onEatFuncfunction?Special function that activates once the object's been deleted (I.E. add to Big Bully #2's condition once a bully has been eaten), can be ignored.


SPECIAL THANKS

@Squishy6094 — Testing, Suggestions, Additional Help
@EmilyEmmi — Help with Footstep Sounds
@Cooliokid 956 — Help with Inhale Vortex Orientation
Various Testers — @charity, "Honii", "Jerik", "Charlotte Lottie Lotte the III", @Syning, @Kristall, @Morishiko, @Jekino, @Kaktus64, "the_silly :3", "trainyoy", @CristobalElMario, "Carlson"... (LMK if I missed anyone else that participated in the testing sessions!)

mods.name: ToeTagger
mods.author: codeflex
mods.description:
ToeTagger is a simple, customizable utility mod that adds a HUD panel which tracks and displays useful live information about all players in the session, and adds floating health bars over other players!

FEATURES:


Colored health bars and HUD elements that match character select colors
Mod menu options that customize the displayed info, health bar scaling type, and more
Health bars display damaged (yellow) and critical (red) health levels
Displays the name of the current romhack, and what caps have been unlocked
Live tracking of players coin tallies, lives counter, current speed, personal star counter, course number, course name, and current star selected
Perfect for PVP DEATHMATCH mod
Displays current NUZLOCKer pool icons (coming soon!)
Compatibility with AFKer (coming soon!)

NEW 2.0 FEATURES:

- RED COINS & 'SECRETS' TRACKER: added an option to independently display both red coins and secrets found in the current level on the ToeTagger panel

- LOWER SIDEBAR: an option to manually lower the ToeTagger sidebar, just in case of custom HUDs. The panel will also automatically lower to accommodate MMX character's custom HUDs.

- POWER-UP MARKER !: Displays a cap-color matched '!' next to the player's health bar on the panel, and next to their in-world character tag

- NAV MARKING Z + DPAD UP: Allows you to place a nav marking that all other players in that level can see and navigate towards. If a star is marked, a star icon will instead appear.

- PLAYER NAV LINES: Adds UI lines that direct you towards other players, with a few different settings:
OFF = Lines are always off
ON = Lines are always on
FAR ONLY = Lines only appear for players who are farther away
DPAD DOWN = Only displays lines when DPAD DOWN is pressed
AFK = Only appears when AFK mode is activated with AFKer ( CURRENTLY DOESNT NOT FUNCTION)
BUBBLE ONLY = Only displays lines when your character is bubbled

- Another option 'ALWAYS SHOW NAV LINES WHEN BUBBLED' will always display lines when bubbled independent of the above setting

- MARK LEARNED ENTRANCES: When a player enters a level, it adds a visible nav point to that entrance. This is learned on a savefile basis, and per romhack basis; if the romhack is changed, or other errors occur you should make sure to use the RESET LEARNED NAV DATA option.

SHOW PLAYERS IN LEVEL: Adds a nav marker to level markers showing if another player is currently in there

(testing thanks: Jxsh, TheDemonChara, Swagmaster, ZenoTheBlueberry and Dukurow)

mods.name: NUZLOCKer
mods.author: codeflex
mods.description:
NUZLOCKer is a mod that allows you to run a highly customizable nuzlocke!
Starting a nuzlocke will assign players a selected pool size of randomly drafted characters
Dying will remove that character from the current pool, and automatically switch you to a new character in your pool
1-ups will award a new character to your pool
Dying on your last character will result in a GAME OVER.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------HOW TO START: Start session > mod menu > NUZLOCKer > choose your settings > START NUZLOCKE                      ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



FEATURES AND OPTIONS:


START NUZLOCKE: Starts a nuzlocke with the current settings
END NUZLOCKE: Ends the current nuzlocke for all players


- POOL TYPE:   GROUP POOLS will draft one pool shared by all players in the session.
                         PERSONAL POOLS will draft individual pools for each player in the session

- RANDOM START: When enabled, randomly selects your first character when the nuzlocke starts; disable this to use your currently selected character

- ALLOW CHARACTER SELECT: Allows players to utilize Character Select during a nuzlocke

- POOL SIZE: Select the amount of characters drafted into the current pools.

- GAME OVER RULE: FREEROAM mode allows players who lose their entire pool are allowed to freeroam, but are left in a flickering, intangible state to mark them as out of the current nuzlocke
                               
                                       1-UP mode allows the player to return to the nuzlocke with one more life, allowing them to rebuild their pool with 1-ups

- MARIO MOVESETS ONLY: Only assigns characters that have basic Mario-equivalent movesets. (Since this couldn't be reliably auto-detected, more whitelisted characters will be added with updates)

- ADD SKINS TO POOL: Treats different skins/costumes as unique characters, and adds them to current pools.

ALLOW PLAYER POOL REROLL: When enabled, allows non-Host players to reroll their current personal pools with the mod menu

ALLOW PLAYER CHARACTER REROLL: When enabled, allows non-Host players to reroll their currently selected character

POOL PANEL: Enables/disables the panel that displays the active pool; disable to play blind.

PALETTE RESPAWN: ON allows other palettes to be selected for pool characters                                 OFF only will use base palettes
                                 CUSTOM will use the player's custom palette
                                  RANDOM will randomize all palettes

- CAP 1-UP POOL SIZE: Caps the pool size, preventing 1-ups from awarding more characters passed the POOL SIZE setting

- QUIT NUZLOCKE: quits the current nuzlocke for you only

- RANDOMIZE CURRENT POOLS: allows the host to force-reroll all active player pools

- RANDOMIZE CURRENT CHARACTERS: allows the host to randomize the characters currently being used by players

- RANDOMIZE MY POOL: when enabled by the host, allows individual players to reroll their current pool

- RANDOMIZE MY CHARACTER: when enabled by the host, allows individual players to reroll their current character

- RESET MOD: ends any current nuzlockes, and refreshes NUZLOCKer (use if bugged or glitched)

- MANUAL SWITCHING: allows players to swap with another character in their pool on-the-fly by holding L + R & DPAD UP or DOWN

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

KNOWN BUGS:

Sometimes, voicebanks get applied wrong, particularly for base SM64COOP characters
Rarely, RANDOMIZE CURRENT CHARACTER/MY CHARACTER will add a character to the current pool
Sometimes palette settings not behaving correctly, or only showing up on the local device
'Game over' mode is intangible to other enemies and players, but player can still collect coins and stars until I find out how to solve this

mods.name: Pause Menu Engine
mods.author: Dan_SM64
mods.description:
Replaces the Pause Menu with a powerful and flexible User Interface. This same engine is used in both PvP Deathmatch and Hide and Seek DX. Mod Developers are free to use this to leverage their own mods, such as cheat menus or full-fledged game modes.



HOW IT WORKS

The menu is a data table containing Pages, Buttons, and Sliders.
Buttons and Sliders are capable of storing and running functions(), enabling power and versatility to both developers and users.
The menu is navigated through user input, and displayed in a manner that supports most resolutions.
The data table can be updated in real time, allowing for more advanced stuff such as hidden buttons, and player lists with switchable values.


FEATURES

Support for multiple pages through page-switching.
Scrolling for when there's several entries in a page.
Colored Names and Values.
Boolean and Integer based Sliders, with the ability to give indexes aliases. Sliders can also be adjusted with multiplied increments.
Pressing X enables Fast Scroll.
Co-op Menu can still be accessed via the R button.
Adjustable Variables used with the engine can be saved and loaded into storage and are remembered between sessions.




CREDITS

Written by Dan
Tiny bit of pause handling code by EmilyEmmi
string_without_hex() function by birdekek
Special Thanks to wereyoshi for a bit of troubleshooting

mods.name: Characters Physics (Explosive Flavour)
mods.author: ExploxionMach64
mods.description:
By the name of the mod, you probably already know what it does: it adds different physics (or stats, if you prefer) to Luigi, Toad, Wario and Waluigi! The mod also changes how maximum speed, acceleration and slopes interact compared to vanilla SM64 physics.

Let´s start talking about the diferrent PHYSICS/STATS the cast can have:
Maxium Speed:

Determines the maximum speed your character can reach through normal acceleration.
NOTE: Is affected by slopes.

Acceleration:

Determines how quickly your character gains speed.
NOTE: Is affected by slopes.

Deceleration:

Determines how quickly your character slows down while braking or turning around.
Characters with high deceleration starts running more faster after turning around.

Jump Height:

Determines how high your character jumps.
Lower jump heights provide more horizontal speed during Wall Kicks, while higher jump heights trade some horizontal speed for extra height.

Swim Speed:

Determines how fast your character swims.
NOTE: This does not affects how fast your character turns while swimming.

Weight:

Affects gravity while falling.
Determines how strongly your character is launched by knockbacks.


Now that you know what each stat does, let's take a look at the stats for each character!

Mario:

Max Speed: Medium | Accel: Medium | Decel: Medium | Jump Height: Medium | Swim Speed: Medium | Weight: Medium

Luigi:

Max Speed: High | Accel: Very Low | Decel: Very Low | Jump Height: Very High | Swim Speed: High | Weight: Low

Toad:

Max Speed: Very High | Accel: Very High | Decel: Low | Jump Height: Very Low | Swim Speed: Very High | Weight: Very Low

Wario:

Max Speed: Medium | Accel: Low | Decel: Very High | Jump Height: Low | Swim Speed: High | Weight: Very High

Waluigi:

Max Speed: Low | Accel: High | Decel: High | Jump Height: High | Swim Speed: Low | Weight: Low

Also, this mod comes with a Mod Menu
Want to check what each stat do or disable the unique physics? Check the mod´s menu!
( Pause → Press R → Mod Menu → Characters Physics (Explosive Flavour) )

character movesets, unique stuff for Mario and even more stuff are planned for future updates, see ya!

mods.name: SIDEKICKer
mods.author: codeflex
mods.description:
SIDEKICKer 
by codeflex

Batman has Robin. Sonic has Tails. And now, you can have a sidekick too!






SIDEKICKer allows players to spawn up to 5 sidekicks that follow and mimic your every move! You can swap characters with your sidekicks, and has full PIGGYBACKer support!

                                                          --------------------HOW TO USE --------------------

- Spawning a new sidekick will duplicate your current character. 
- Holding L + R and pressing DPAD UP/DOWN will switch your active character to the next side kick
- Entering Character Select and changing character only changes the character you're playing ass; all sidekicks independently retain their character and palettes
- If a sidekick gets separated, they will attempt to reset, spinjumping back down to you. You can force an immediate reset by holding L + R
- Pressing DPAD DOWN will make your sidekicks ride your character


                                                          ----------- OTHER FEATURES ------------

MINI-ME mode: Makes your sidekicks tiny!
MATCH PALETTE: Your sidekicks will always try and match your current character's palette
DELTA FORMATION: When you have 2 or more sidekicks, they will follow you in a delta formation instead of a line
ENABLE PIGGY STACKS: Allows or disables sidekick piggybacking with DPAD DOWN
PIGGYBACKer SUPPORT: If PIGGYBACKer is enabled, riding another player will make your sidekicks ride their available sidekicks
< REDACTED > SUPPORT: 💩💩💩💩💩

(note; please update all -er series mods to latest available versions for full compatibility)

mods.name: Tiny QoL Pack
mods.author: ExploxionMach64
mods.description:
This mod adds a few quality-of-life features to make the gameplay a bit more enjoyable.

Here's what it includes:

Coyote Time
(Taken from my Characters Physics (Explosive Flavour) mod.)
Gives you a few extra frames to jump after leaving the ground. It also works with Double Jumps, Triple Jumps, Rollouts, Wing Cap Triple Jumps, and more.

Star Heal
Don't like being forced to leave the level after collecting a Power Star? Me neither! That's why I made this feature. Collecting a Power Star now fully restores your health, even if you've already collected that star before.

Longer Metal/Vanish Caps
Doubles the duration of the Metal Cap and Vanish Cap. They now last 40 seconds instead of 20! I've always wondered why the Wing Cap lasts a full minute while the other two only last 20 seconds.

That's all! I wanted to make something small and simple. You can also toggle each feature individually from the mod menu.

( Pause → Press R → Mod Menu → Tiny QoL Pack )
See ya!

mods.name: ⚙️ Multiplayer QoL Settings
mods.author: Slack
mods.description:
Description
Adds a handful of quality of life settings that aim to reduce some of the idling you might encounter when playing with a group! Settings include:


Shared Cannons - Everybody can hop into the same cannon at the same time! Sit back while your friends figure out where to aim, and make those small adjustments when your turn rolls around. If you get tired of waiting, you can always press Z or B to hop out early
Bubble Anywhere - Hold L to enter your bubble from anywhere without losing health or lives! Handy for when you just want to regroup with folks but don't wanna find the nearest hazard to deplete your healthbar
Multiple Cap Spawns - Exclamation boxes spawn a cap (or koopa shell) for every player loaded into the level! No more missing out on a fun star because your friend got to the cap first
Multiple Key Spawns - Everybody can collect the Bowser key after a Bowser fight! Ensures your group ends up in the same area after the fight ends
Infinite Lives - Gives all players in the server unlimited lives! Keeps that one friend from getting booted back to spawn repeatedly. This one is toggled off by default.


As the server host, you can toggle all of these settings on/off from the Mod Menu, which can be accessed by pausing and pressing the R button!

Mod Showcase



Extra Details
For folks who want a bit more customization (such as changing the button used for the bubble), I've got some additional info / instructions in the README:
https://github.com/StackingSlack/multiplayer-qol-settings

Thanks for checking out the mod! Cap palettes / models aside, if you run into any networking issues / desyncs, especially around the cannon sharing feature, please let me know! I was only able to do tests with 4 players at a time, so I'm not sure how well cannon sharing will stay synced across a full lobby!

mods.name: ColorSHIFTer
mods.author: codeflex
mods.description:
ColorSHIFTer 1.0
by codeflex


ColorSHIFTer 1.0 is the full release version of the animated palette system for SM64CoopDX. It allows players to transform normal or custom palettes into animated, reactive, multiplayer-synced color effects using the standard mod menu.

-------------------- CORE FEATURES --------------------


Added full per-slot palette animation support for Overalls, Shirt, Gloves, Shoes, Hair, Skin, and Hat.
Each palette slot can be enabled or disabled independently.
Disabled slots preserve the player’s normal selected palette color.
Each slot supports 4 selectable color channels.
Color channels can use black, white, hue values, bypass, or the original palette color.
Added per-slot Speed controls.
Added per-slot Brightness controls.
Added support for normal palettes and custom palettes.
Added multiplayer syncing so players can see each other’s ColorSHIFTer effects.
Added SIDEKICKer Match Palette support.

-------------------- SLOT MODES --------------------

ORBIT
Colors rotate through the selected color channels with offset timing between slots, creating a layered animated palette effect.

SCROLL
Colors move steadily through the selected channels in a smooth scrolling loop.

PULSE
Colors swell in and out between selected channels, creating a breathing glow effect.

FLICKER
Colors rapidly jump and shift through the selected channels for unstable, electric, chaotic, or glitch-style palettes.

SPEED BASED
Color animation speed reacts to player movement speed. Slower movement creates slower shifting, while faster movement increases the animation rate.

ATTACK
Slots remain normal until the player performs B-button attacks or ground pounds. The slot fires up almost instantly, then fades back down based on the slot’s Speed setting.

-------------------- SLOT OVERRIDES --------------------

OFF
Uses the selected slot mode normally.

RAINBOW
Overrides the selected color channels and cycles the slot through a full rainbow.

RANDOM COLORS
Continuously generates random shifting colors for that slot.

SHIMMER
Creates a fast shimmering effect using the slot’s selected color channels.

-------------------- GLOBAL OVERRIDES --------------------

OFF
No global override. Slots use their own individual settings.

SHIMMER
Cycles through enabled slots from head to toe, briefly highlighting one slot at a time.

SHADOW
Cycles through enabled slots while all non-active enabled slots become black.

SHINE
Cycles through enabled slots while all non-active enabled slots become white.

INVERTED
Cycles through enabled slots by inverting the original palette color for the active slot.

SPEED
Forces enabled slots to animate based on player movement speed.

PRISM
Applies a vivid prism-style color spread across all enabled slots.

NEON

mods.name: MASTER COMPATIBILITY PATCH FOR -er SERIES
mods.author: codeflex
mods.description:
MASTER COMPATIBILITY FOR -er SERIES MODS
Category: Resource

MASTER COMPATIBILITY 1.0 (July 26th 2026)
========================
The individual MarioFIGHTer and PIGGYBACKer compatibility patches replace someof the same files for mods such as MMX or Link: HotPS. Applying one patch after the other would remove the firstpatch's changes. This package provides combined replacement files that retainboth mods' compatibility behavior.Combines the compatibility files distributed with:

MarioFIGHTer 1.6.0
PIGGYBACKer 1.2.0

SUPPORTED TARGET MODS

Link HotPS v1.2.2
MMX v1.2.14
Metal Sonic & Knuckles
Petey Piranha
SSB Pikachu
SMRPG Characters

COLLISIONS RESOLVED

[CS] Link HotPS\src\hooks.luaRetains PIGGYBACKer rider handling and adds MarioFIGHTer fight inventory.



mmx_v1.2.14\c-0_hitbox.luaRetains PIGGYBACKer MMX hitbox handling and adds MarioFIGHTer projectilecollision and direct fight-damage support.



[CS] SSB Pikachu\src\hooks.luaRetains PIGGYBACKer Pikachu handling and adds MarioFIGHTer Electro Ballfight-damage support.

INSTALLATION

Install the supported target character mods in the sm64coopdx mods folder.
Install MarioFIGHTer 1.6.0 and PIGGYBACKer 1.2.0.
Back up the target character folders before replacing files.
Copy every mod folder from this package into the sm64coopdx mods folder.
Allow the folders and files to merge and replace matching files.
Do not apply the older individual MarioFIGHTer or PIGGYBACKer compatibilityZIPs afterward, because they would overwrite these combined files.
Reload mods or restart the game.

Inspired by Adventure Quest and Mario RPG I give you.... Plumber's Quest 64

Spells with effects
Quests, lootboxes, and temporary buffs
Partner companion (WIP , Luigi may look a little odd, thats just a feature!)
Bomb King and Bowser boss fights (Lvl 10 and Lvl 15 unlock)
1v1 player duels
Progress saving
"/pq enable" to enable/disable the mod
"/pq help" or "/pq" for a list of commands
"/pq duel <player name>" to fight your friends!





You can start it by dragging the mod into your mods folder (PQ64-v1.0)
Then inside the game select the mod "Plumber's Quest 64 v1.0 (Release)" to toggle it enabled.

CREDITS:

Made by CrypticTM
Playtesters: demon77727, happysharks, jasiel, piccolo, vainXD, wrenfloof11 and more!

Known issues: 
Bob-omb, Scuttlebug, and Bully enemies can still move or act a little on their own during battles (freeze is not 100% reliable on them yet)
Bowser fight uses a simplified behavior for stability - he won’t do his full vanilla AI, or shouldn't.

Very rare desync possible in multiplayer if a player joins mid-battle
Mario's HP not adjusted correctly, this might cause you to take damage from enemies outside of combat.

mods.name: Extra Chat Commands
mods.author: CrazyDany
mods.description:
Lacking commands for RP and players interaction? Say no more!
Extra Chat Commands is the second mod in a collection designed to enhance player interaction and roleplay elements.



The mod introduces several new commands with extensive customization options and support for dynamic arguments.

/whisp — allows you to send anonymous and private messages to other players.
/mute and /unmute — allows you to restrict a player from typing in chat.
/tp — allows you to quickly teleport to another player.
/alert — allows you to create a minimalist, customizable notification for all players at the top of the screen.

Special attention should be paid to the warp command group, which allows you to create and customize warp points for fast travel. You can create points, set them to private, grant access to specific players, view existing points and their owners, and most importantly — save and load them between game sessions!


Every command provides nice, readable output, includes sounds for better feedback, supports colors, and makes for a really pleasant interaction.

The mod respects admin and moderator permissions, restricting certain commands for regular players to ensure a safe and controlled environment.
For more information, use the /help command in-game.

We plan to release updates with new commands in the future. We are also open to your feedback and suggestions!

Enjoy the game and your experience with the mod! :)

mods.author: ProfeJavix
mods.description:
Commisioned by Asha

Asha The Crocodile has a wrestling moveset to cause pain to their enemies! This character is a grappler, which means they can hold heavy objects without slowing down. Also you can toggle Grappler Mode, which means you'll be able to grab a lot more of stuff than usual.

MOVESET

Double Lariat: Extend your arms and start spinning. Become invincible and punch enemies.
Flying Body Press: Perform a huge jump and send shockwaves on ground pound. You'll grab a collided object if Grappler Mode is active.
Water Ground Pound: Use your strength to ground pound even in water!
Death Roll: Spin while in water to move fast and hit every foe in your way.
Spinning Pile Driver: Spin and drop at a high speed while holding something and send shockwaves on ground pound.
Spin Throw: Spin in place and release the held object to throw it at a massive speed.


Type /asha-help to show Asha's controls. Also check the Mod Menu to disable player grab while in Grappler Mode in case you don't wanna use this mechanic.

Ditch the outdated interface and level up your multiplayer experience. Advanced HUD completely reimagines how you look at your screen, injecting high-performance clarity and modular customization into every single lobby session.

Why You Need This:

True Aspect Scaling: Zero stretching, zero clutter. Every visual element perfectly scales to your display resolution automatically and manually.
True Aspect Opacity: Customizable HUD opacity.
Smart Multi-Character Recolors: Say goodbye to generic icons. Custom head textures for Mario, Luigi, Toad, Wario, Waluigi, and any CS instantly adapt to match player colors dynamically in real time (Dynamic Lives Icon by EmilyEmmi).
Zero Overhead: Engineered to look like a modern, official extension of the game while maintaining buttery-smooth, uncompromised frame rates in massive 16-player rooms.
